policy: This additive ledger proves serialization against retained source MXL where possible. It never authorizes promotion. Alternate-edition witnesses and OMR drafts remain review-only; unmodeled lyrics/repeats/shapes are explicit semantic limitations.

differenceTaxonomy.draft-is-not-authoritative-source: Draft score is excluded from source-authoritative verification.
differenceTaxonomy.event-stream-diff: Parts, pitch, duration, rests, ties, voice, staff, accidentals, or notehead event serialization differs.
differenceTaxonomy.measure-count-diff: Source and generated event-bearing measure identities differ after recorded transforms.
differenceTaxonomy.repeat-ending-semantics-not-modeled-in-g: Source has repeat or ending directives not represented in the generated asset.
differenceTaxonomy.sound-navigation-semantics-not-modeled-i: Source has sound navigation directives not represented in the generated asset.
differenceTaxonomy.lyrics-not-modeled-in-generated-asset: Source contains lyrics that are not represented in the generated asset.
differenceTaxonomy.shape-notehead-count-differs: Source and generated shape-notehead counts differ.
differenceTaxonomy.key-declaration-differs: Source key declaration differs from the generated asset declaration.
differenceTaxonomy.time-signature-differs: Source time declaration differs from the generated asset time signature.
differenceTaxonomy.retained-source-mxl-unavailable: No retained independent MusicXML witness is available.
differenceTaxonomy.manifest-source-path-missing: Manifest names a retained source path that is not present.
differenceTaxonomy.witness-is-not-exact-edition-source: The available witness is a reference or alternate-edition source.
differenceTaxonomy.source-checksum-drift: Retained source bytes differ from the manifest checksum.
